hypothesis: get_verified_user falls back to client-supplied X-User-ID when Authorization header is absent, allowing arbitrary attackers to impersonate any user UUID and access/mutate their private resources without cryptographic credentials.

get_trip_by_id serializes the creator's raw UUID in created_by and all members' raw UUIDs in members list to all collaborators. An attacker who is invited to or views a trip can harvest the victim's UUID and use it to log into the victim's account via the landing page recovery input.

get_expenses returns created_by and payer_id raw UUIDs for all expense records in a shared trip without masking. Any collaborator can extract the owner's UUID from the expenses endpoint even if trips.py is masked.

The leave_trip endpoint at line 1247 bypasses get_verified_user dependency and directly injects Header(None, alias='X-User-ID'). An attacker can spoof another user's ID to force members out or manipulate trip state without any JWT.
